Both changes are implemented, formatted, and lint-clean.

**`validate_key`** (`airflow-core/src/airflow/utils/helpers.py`) — added a `".." in k` check after the existing type/length/charset checks, raising `AirflowException` with the exact message `The key '{key}' must not contain consecutive dots ('..') to prevent path traversal`. Since `.` is allowed by `KEY_REGEX`, keys like `my..key` and `..` pass the regex but are now caught by this new check.

**`validate_run_id`** (`airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dagrun.py`) — added a `".." in run_id` check before the regex/pattern checks, raising `ValueError` with a message containing `must not contain '..'`. A literal substring check catches all `..` forms: plain (`my..run`), bare `..`, and URL-encoded variants like `manual__..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd` (which still contains a literal `..`).

I left the `tests/` directory untouched as instructed. Note: I couldn't run the test suite via `uv`/`breeze` here (the sandbox can't compile `python-ldap`), but `ruff format` and `ruff check` both pass on the edited files.
